# Lee Mulvey

> Full-stack engineer based in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada, focused on building thoughtful products and interfaces with TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Node.js.

Personal site and portfolio for Lee Mulvey.

## Pages

- [Home](https://leemulvey.com/): Introduction, background, and the tech stack he reaches for.
- [Projects](https://leemulvey.com/projects): Shipped work, experiments, and client builds.
- [Blog](https://leemulvey.com/blog): Occasional posts, plus film reviews synced from Letterboxd.
- [Contact](https://leemulvey.com/contact): Ways to get in touch — email, GitHub, LinkedIn, resume, and more.

## Notes

- Built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
- Code: https://github.com/lmulvey
